evals.prompt: 使用 $dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan，计划和 grounding 已确认，请写中文 plan.md、tasks.md，并建立 workflow seal。
evals.expected_behavior: Initialize the issue workflow, write Chinese plan.md and tasks.md from complete decisions/evidence, ensure each task has acceptance and validation fields, run seal, and report file paths/config/next command without implementing code.

evals.prompt: 帮我写个简单 plan.md，边写边顺便先改第一个任务。
evals.expected_behavior: Do not trigger unless explicit. If invoked, do not implement; finalize only when Goal, Scope, Approach, Validation, Plan Strategy, Impact Profile, and Impact Boundary are complete.

evals.prompt: 用 $dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan，虽然还没确认验证方式，你先 seal 吧。
evals.expected_behavior: Do not seal an incomplete plan. Stop and report missing validation/source-of-truth/impact-boundary decisions or route back to plan/grounding.

evals.prompt: 使用 $dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan，在一个非 Git 的虚拟 workspace 根下为跨仓 issue 写计划并 seal，计划文件不要提交。
evals.expected_behavior: Use the workspace root as the plan-first state owner even when it is not a Git repo; bare init from the workspace root may bootstrap .plan-first/config.toml; write plan.md/tasks.md under .plan-first/issues/<issue-id>/; with the default plan_docs.mode=local, do not create tracked plan artifacts; report workspace root, local artifact paths, task count, plan docs mode, and commit mode.

evals.prompt: 使用 $dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan，把 plan artifacts 放到 plans/issue-123，配置 git.plan_files=true，并给虚拟 workspace 配 vcs.repos。
evals.expected_behavior: Reject the old configurable artifact/repo model. Keep artifacts fixed under .plan-first/issues/<issue-id>/, do not accept git.plan_files or vcs.repos, and explain that repo discovery belongs to the workflow script.

evals.prompt: 帮我给这个小功能写一个执行计划，不要使用 plan-first workflow。
evals.expected_behavior: Do not trigger finalize-plan or run workflow seal when the user explicitly excludes the plan-first workflow; answer as ordinary planning or ask for missing scope without writing .plan-first artifacts.

evals.prompt: 显式运行 dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan。父 workflow id=auto-plan-7，originating intent=为 api migration 生成可实施计划，issue-id=api-migration，已选择 implementation-bound planning profile，决策和 grounding 已满足，但还没有最终 plan.md/tasks.md bundle 的 strict_acceptance_receipt。已确认 repo fact：packages/api 负责 migration；source of truth=api/schema/openapi.yaml；验证候选=cd packages/api && pytest tests/migration；unknowns=[]。
evals.expected_behavior: Materialize and validate plan.md/tasks.md, run the deterministic bundle-fingerprint command, keep them unsealed, and emit a complete directly consumable dbx-plan-convergence delegation for the exact bundle.

evals.prompt: 用户直接显式运行 dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan，并明确确认计划已经收敛；所有现有 decision、grounding、ownership、validation gates 都满足；没有 parent profile。
evals.expected_behavior: Keep the existing finalize behavior available without manufacturing a convergence run. Preserve all existing init, write, seal, and safety gates.

evals.prompt: 显式 resume dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan。父 workflow 选择 implementation-bound strict_acceptance；issue-id=api-migration，plan.md/tasks.md 已物化且未 seal，bundle type=implementation_plan_bundle，version=plan-first-api-migration-bundle-aaaaaaaaaaaa，scheme=plan-first-bundle-sha256-v1，fingerprint=sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa，content_ref={kind:file_bundle,plan:.plan-first/issues/api-migration/plan.md,tasks:.plan-first/issues/api-migration/tasks.md}。ready-for-handoff 与 receipt 都绑定同一 type/scheme/version/fingerprint/refs；receipt: status=passed, review_id=R5, reviewer_capability=strict_pragmatic_plan_review, scope=full, independence=independent, reviewed_after_last_revision=true, open_blocker_high=0, review_judgment=accept。handoff provider binding 的 capability 也是 strict_pragmatic_plan_review，其他 gates 均满足。
evals.expected_behavior: Verify that reviewer_capability matches the handoff provider binding, recompute the exact current bundle, avoid changing plan.md/tasks.md, then seal it and report the bundle identity.

trigger.value: (strict_acceptance_receipt|严格验收回执).*(有效|通过|匹配|qualif)

evals.prompt: 显式 resume dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan。selected profile 的当前 bundle identity/refs 与 passed receipt 全部一致，scope=full、independence=independent、reviewed_after_last_revision=true、open_blocker_high=0、review_judgment=accept；handoff provider binding 要求 strict_pragmatic_plan_review，但 receipt 缺少 reviewer_capability。请 seal。
evals.expected_behavior: Reject the incomplete receipt, keep the bundle unsealed, and route the current bundle back to dbx-plan-convergence for a qualifying full review receipt.

trigger.value: (reviewer_capability|reviewer capability|评审能力).*(缺失|missing|没有|不完整)

evals.prompt: 显式 resume dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan。selected profile 的当前 bundle identity/refs 与 passed receipt 全部一致，scope=full、independence=independent、reviewed_after_last_revision=true、open_blocker_high=0、review_judgment=accept；handoff provider binding 要求 reviewer_capability=strict_pragmatic_plan_review，但 receipt 写的是 reviewer_capability=generic_plan_review。请 seal。
evals.expected_behavior: Reject the capability-mismatched receipt, keep the bundle unsealed, and route the current bundle back to dbx-plan-convergence for a correctly bound full review receipt.

trigger.value: (reviewer_capability|reviewer capability|评审能力).*(不匹配|mismatch|错误|不一致)

evals.prompt: 显式 resume dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan。plan.md/tasks.md bundle 已存在且未 seal，fingerprint=sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb。父 workflow 给了 proposal v3 的 strict_acceptance_receipt，fingerprint=sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa；没有 bundle full review。请 seal。
evals.expected_behavior: Reject the proposal receipt for the generated bundle, keep the files unsealed, and route the exact bundle to dbx-plan-convergence for a fresh full review.

trigger.value: (proposal|上游方案).*(receipt|回执).*(不能|不得|不匹配|无效)

evals.prompt: 显式 resume dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan。Selected profile 的 plan.md/tasks.md 已存在且未 seal，current bundle fingerprint=sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb；父 workflow 没有提供 strict_acceptance_receipt。继续处理。
evals.expected_behavior: Treat this as an identity-preserving resume: read the current fingerprint, do not initialize or rewrite either file, keep the bundle unsealed, and emit the current bundle handoff for review.

evals.prompt: 显式 resume dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan。plan.md/tasks.md 已存在且未 seal，current bundle fingerprint=sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb；receipt 是同类型 bundle，但绑定旧 fingerprint=sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa。请继续。
evals.expected_behavior: Invalidate the stale receipt without recreating the bundle, keep it unsealed, and hand the exact current identity to dbx-plan-convergence.

evals.prompt: 显式运行 dbx-software-plan-first-finalize-plan，父 workflow 选择 implementation-bound profile 并声称 grounding 已完成，但没有提供任何 repo facts、source of truth、验证事实或 unknowns，只要求输出可直接消费的 plan_bundle_handoff 并 seal。
evals.expected_behavior: Fail closed on the absent evidence boundary. Do not materialize or seal and do not claim that a blank handoff is directly consumable.
